plugin.name: Mafia: Definitive Edition Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Goes straight to the main menu, past the middleware logos, the disclaimer page, the 2K and Hangar 13 logo movie and the "Press Enter to start" screen. Off shows them as in the original game. Needs a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Choose the language used for the fix’s settings text. Auto follows the game or editor language.
